title: Show HN: How random are you?
summary: SPEC/R Lab created an interactive web experiment that tests how 'random' users' choices really are, revealing the psychological biases and patterns in human-generated randomness versus true randomness.
problem_solved: Demonstrates that humans are poor at generating truly random sequences due to cognitive biases
why_valuable: Provides an engaging way to understand human cognitive limitations in probability and randomness through hands-on experimentation
